name: Famulor AI - Voice Agent
desc: AI-powered calling and SMS platform. Automate outbound campaigns, manage leads, and get real-time call analytics.

actions.name: addLead
actions.description: Add a lead to an outbound campaign to be called by an AI assistant.

actions.name: listLeads
actions.description: List all leads in your account.

actions.name: listPhoneNumbers
actions.description: List all phone numbers linked to your account.

actions.name: searchAvailablePhoneNumbers
actions.description: Search for phone numbers available to purchase.

actions.name: purchasePhoneNumber
actions.description: Purchase a phone number from the available search results.

actions.name: sendSms
actions.description: Send an SMS message using one of your purchased phone numbers.

actions.name: createCampaign
actions.description: Create a new outbound calling campaign.

actions.name: campaignControl
actions.description: Start or stop an outbound calling campaign.

actions.name: makePhoneCall
actions.description: Initiate an AI-powered phone call to a customer.

actions.name: updateLead
actions.description: Update an existing lead's details.

actions.name: deleteLead
actions.description: Permanently delete a lead and abort any ongoing calls.

actions.name: getCurrentUser
actions.description: Retrieve the authenticated user's profile and account balance.

actions.name: generateAiReply
actions.description: Generate an AI reply from an assistant for a given customer.

actions.name: createConversation
actions.description: Start a new chat conversation with an AI assistant.

actions.name: getConversation
actions.description: Retrieve the full message history for a conversation.

actions.name: sendMessage
actions.description: Send a message to an existing conversation and receive the assistant's reply.

actions.name: getWhatsAppSenders
actions.description: List WhatsApp Business senders linked to your account.

actions.name: getWhatsAppTemplates
actions.description: List approved WhatsApp message templates for a sender.

actions.name: sendWhatsAppTemplate
actions.description: Send an approved WhatsApp template message via a Famulor sender.

actions.name: sendWhatsAppFreeform
actions.description: Send a free-text WhatsApp message within an active 24-hour session.

actions.name: getWhatsAppSessionStatus
actions.description: Check if a 24-hour WhatsApp messaging session is active for a sender and recipient.

actions.name: listConversations
actions.description: List conversations with optional filters.

actions.name: listCalls
actions.description: List calls with optional filters.

actions.name: getCall
actions.description: Retrieve details for a call by ID, including transcript and recording.

actions.name: deleteCall
actions.description: Permanently delete a call record including its transcript and recording.

triggers.name: phoneCallEnded
triggers.description: Triggers when a phone call completes.

triggers.name: conversationEnded
triggers.description: Triggers when a chat conversation ends.

triggers.name: getAssistants
triggers.description: Triggers when AI assistants are created or updated in your Famulor account.

triggers.name: inboundCall
triggers.description: Triggers when an inbound call is received by your AI assistant.
